frequency_question: What proportion of nominated agency heads complete the full confirmation process within 70 days or less from initial nomination?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations submitted to the Senate for executive branch agency leadership positions requiring confirmation, excluding judicial appointments.
coverage_note: Sample of recent FDA Commissioner confirmations and key health agency nominations; broader regulatory heads show similar procedural timelines.
known_gaps: Excludes recess appointments and unconfirmed nominees who withdrew before committee action.
skeleton: Nomination submission to committee questionnaire (14 days) + background check (14 days) + committee hearing and markup (21 days) + floor scheduling and vote (25 days) = total minimum sequential calendar days required under standard non-accelerated Senate procedure.
multiplier: 14 + 14 + 21 + 25 = 74 calendar days minimum required process time.
validity_reason: Valid until the end of the current presidential term and Senate procedural ruleset.
